args.query: INSERT INTO shared_export (recipient_org, payload, created_at) SELECT 'partner university', json_group_array(json_object('session_id', session_id, 'participant_id', participant_id, 'condition', condition, 'cognitive_score', cognitive_score, 'reaction_ms', reaction_ms, 'recorded_at', recorded_at, 'status', status, 'notes', notes)), datetime('now') FROM (SELECT * FROM measurements WHERE recorded_at = (SELECT max(recorded_at) FROM measurements) ORDER BY session_id);
